name: logicq-monorepo
description: LogicQ — Competitive C Programming Arena & Daily Challenges

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
